Transwestern's average deliveries to California were 854 MMBtu/d (78%), with San Juan lateral throughput at 844 MMBtu/d.  Total East deliveries averaged 473 MMBtu/d.  

El Paso's average deliveries to California were 1783 MMBtu/d (61%):
- PG&ETop, capacity of 1140 MMBtu/d, deliveries of 374 MMBtu/d (33%)
- SoCalEhr, capacity 1250 MMBtu/d, deliveries of 954 MMBtu/d (76%)
- SoCalTop, capacity 540 MMBtu/d, deliveries of 455 MMBtu/d (84%)
